newsitem.title: USA: U.S. aluminum orders improve in August - Spector.
newsitem.headline: U.S. aluminum orders improve in August - Spector.

text.p: August aluminum mill product orders in the U.S. improved from July and were also up compared to a year ago, industry analyst Stewart Spector said.
Excluding can sheet, orders were at their best levels since 1994.
On a seasonally adjusted basis, August orders averaged 59.8 million lbs per day, up 7.5 percent from the year-ago level and the 58.2 million lbs per day booked in July.
Can sheet orders continue to lag the year-ago level by nearly 20 percent due to cooler weather, sluggish beer consumption and a further runoff of can stock inventories at can plants.

"The pick-up in non can sheet mill product orders in the last few months reflects the rise in industrial activity, and the need for the manufacturing sector to probably start to rebuild some stocks," Spector said.
